ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) surface area to low-intensity (black) peripheral and central boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central field. Dark pigmentation (mottling) is concentrated at the peduncle insertion point and along the narrow trailing edge. Small discrete dark pixel clusters are visible on the medial-right lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations across both lobes; a prominent high-amplitude indentation (notch) is located on the right lobe trailing edge, approximately 75% lateral from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters detected on the inner-right lobe near the central axis.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical dark linear mark (rake-like scar) intersecting the trailing edge on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep vertical notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; distinct linear dark scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast black/white fragmented pigmentation pattern at the junction where the peduncle meets the fluke blades.
